segments.text: Welcome to DansLab. I'm Dan. This channel is for people who don't just watch AI happen — they build businesses with it. In the next five minutes I'll show you everything we've built here, and how you can join our AI Business Network.

A quick word about me. I play poker, I run KryptoStack Exchange, and I'm honestly in love with technology. DansLab is my lab: a Mac Studio fleet, local models, and a team of AI agents that work day and night. Everything you'll see today was built here.

Even this video is made in our own studio, StreamStudio. I write the script, and the system directs everything else: the scenes, the cards, even where my hands point. AI isn't the topic here. It's the crew.

Let's start with Fake-Real. The internet is full of claims, so we built a tool that checks them. You paste a link, and our evidence engine, JEV, reads the page, pulls out every factual claim, searches outside sources and compares. You get REAL or FAKE, with the sources. And when there isn't enough evidence, it tells you that too.
Three free checks a day, no account needed, in English and Romanian. Fake-Real is live today.

Next: NervixPay, the payment rail of the whole network. Accepting crypto becomes as easy as a QR code. Your customer pays from their own wallet, the money lands straight in yours, and we verify every payment on-chain. We never touch your funds.

USDT and USDC on Polygon, Ethereum and BNB Chain. The fee is zero point two percent, capped at two dollars. Payment links, a pay button, an API, and safe expiring keys, so even AI agents can get paid.

Then there's Zmarty, our AI trading companion. It isn't just a chatbot: it's a team of specialised agents watching the markets around the clock and explaining what they see, in a chat that feels like WhatsApp, with voice. The more you talk to it, the better it knows your style.
Behind me, KryptoStack Exchange, the exchange I lead.
And that gold coin in the glass case is iRise, our own coin: the token we're building our ecosystem around.
Fake-Real. NervixPay. Zmarty. KryptoStack. iRise. Five projects, one idea: AI businesses that work together. That is the AI Business Network, and this channel is its home.
So we're opening the doors. We're launching Nervix Market: a place where anyone can list an AI project — an app, an agent, a tool, or a whole business — so people can find it, use it, or buy it.

What can you list? An AI app people can use today. An agent that does a real job. A tool for creators, traders or teams. Or a whole business you want to sell. Every listing gets its own page: what it does, the price, and how to reach you. And people can search by category.

Listing takes a ten-dollar membership, paid in USDT or USDC, through NervixPay of course. You pay from your own wallet, the payment is verified on-chain, and your business goes live in the network. No banks, no waiting.
Once it's live, share your page everywhere. Interested users and buyers come straight to you.
Why join? You get in front of people who are actively looking for AI solutions. You sit next to projects like ours. And the best businesses in the network get shown right here, on this channel.
If you're building with AI, this is your place. Subscribe, follow the link in the description, and list your project on Nervix Market. I'm Dan, this is DansLab. Let's build the future together.
